data.body: Progress update: implemented and locally committed the gate_status/REVIEW_RESULT readiness fix at b5aad2979d72f6ad549d42af3b985e69007f3c08 in worktree /Users/joeoakhart/debug-gate-status-sidecar. Validation passed: targeted async gate tests, MCP schema coverage with the target tests, mutation tooth check, make lint, make typecheck, python -m rebar.schemas.check_mcp_models --check, and full make test with ambient Git config cleared (GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=0). Commit trailer verified with rebar verify-commit-ticket --rev HEAD. Gerrit push is currently blocked by external connectivity: repeated git push gerrit HEAD:refs/for/main attempts and HTTPS/SSH probes to rebar.solutions.navateam.com fail with SSL/banner timeouts. No design-decision escalation was hit; landing/closing remain pending until Gerrit is reachable.
